GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.8 (30 Jan 46) CIE
(SCAPIN - 680)
APO 500
30 January 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Suspension of YAMAOKA, Mannosuke, President, Nippon University, Tokyo.
The Imperial Japanese Government, on receipt of this memorandum, will suspend YAMAOKA, Mannosuke from the Presidency of Nippon University, Tokyo, and will prohibit his employment by Japanese educational institutions and agencies, both public and private, until such time as he has been screened in compliance with provisions of Memorandum AG350(30 Oct 45)CIE, "Investigation, screening, and Certification of Teachers and Educational Officials."
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
